transport.failureSemantics: Any non-200 status, transport error or undecodable body is treated as a refusal by the plugin.

serverTarget.host: IP address already checked by the bridge
serverTarget.tlsPeerName: Host name verified against the server certificate
serverTarget.password: real mailbox password; only ever in this response

uids: strings, exactly as Roundcube parsed them: 12, 12:40

request.origin: Origin header the plugin already matched against the Orbit origin

/v1/handoff/consume.notes: Atomic. The token is not consumed when the plugin rejects the Origin, because the bridge is not called.

200.projectId: optional, not yet in bridge-contract.ts; needed for the convert link of a page that is not embedded
200.email: mailbox address, used for the identity and the From check

/v1/session/authorize.notes: Called once per PHP request and memoized for the action check, IMAP and SMTP. The plugin reads the error code from the body whatever the non-200 status.

/v1/session/barrier.notes: Only status ok lets the action run. Selection type all is a superset when a search narrows _uid=*.

browserToWebmail.handoff: POST https://<webmail-host>/ with form fields _task=login, _action=login, _orbit_handoff=<token>; the Origin header must equal the Orbit origin

ready.notes: Sent whenever a top-level Roundcube page of a live session finished rendering, so more than once per session.

webmailToParent.convertWhenNotEmbedded: <orbit origin>/p/<projectId>/webmail?mailbox=<mailboxId>&convert=1&folder=<folder>&uid=<uid>&uidValidity=<uidValidity>, opened as a link instead of a message, every value URL-encoded

sessionLost.reason: session_unknown | session_revoked | session_expired | not_authorized | mailbox_unavailable | bridge_unavailable | no_session | handoff_failed
sessionLost.notes: mailbox_unavailable and bridge_unavailable leave the Roundcube session intact and are only sent when a full page could not be shown; everything else ended the session. Roundcube's background polling never sends a temporary reason.
